credits.title: Love in a Hopeless Place
credits.overview: Modern dating sucks. Deidre is looking for love but she also has the luxury of feeding off them when they don't work out.

credits.title: Crowning at the Prom
credits.overview: On the brink of prom queen glory and a coveted athletic scholarship, obsessive overachiever Kat Walker is determined to maintain the flawless image she's built for herself and for her devoted single mother, Abigail.

credits.title: Walk Me Home
credits.overview: A non-binary person has an unnerving experience getting home after a party.

credits.title: The Rebrand
credits.overview: Nicole, an eight months-pregnant videographer is hired by a lesbian lifestyle influencer couple to film a redemption documentary after they’ve been publicly cancelled, but Nicole quickly discovers that the couple have nefarious ulterior motives.

credits.title: Bangs
credits.overview: A woman on the brink of 30 cuts her hair moments before hosting her birthday dinner and struggles to cope when nobody seems to notice.
